reasoning: The caller asks only to animate the supplied still with slow drifting motion: no spoken lines, no visible words, no replacement figure, no new scene event. The single attached image is wired as the first-frame anchor, so the ENTIRE composite reference sheet — hero panel, FRONT/SIDE PROFILE/BACK turnaround panels, FACE/JACKET COLLAR/HANDS/BOOTS detail panels, its panel layout and its existing labels — must remain intact as the full supplied frame at the anchored instant, never cropped into a hero shot and never stripped of its lettering. Life is therefore given by continuous, gentle camera drift and by subtle in-frame ambience (falling rain and shimmering city lights in the hero panel, faint sheen on the wet railing), not by redesigning the sheet. A single continuous take covers the whole 5167ms with no cut that would merely restate the same change; the slow push keeps every panel and label in the frame while the drifting motion reads as breathing life into the photo. Balanced creativity permits, but does not require, an added score; since the request is a quiet photographic drift and nothing in the scope asks for music, none is added and no speech or on-screen text is introduced. Camera motion is deliberately small and slow to honour 'slow drifting'.

shots.action: The complete character reference sheet holds as one continuous frame while slow drifting motion brings it to life: rain streaks fall steadily through the top hero panel, city lights behind the railing pulse and blur into soft bokeh, a sheen of water slides along the metal railing, and the figure in the hero panel draws a slow breath with the faintest shift of shoulders and jacket collar. Every panel — hero, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS — stays fully visible in place with all of its existing labels legible, and the near-black, charcoal, slate-blue and warm-amber grade with low-key cool ambient light is untouched.
sync_sound: faint wet-city hum and distant traffic wash
shots.what_changes: The static sheet begins to live: rain falls, background lights shimmer, water sheens on the railing, and the framed figure breathes, while the full panel layout and all labels remain exactly in place.
